description: Enhanced self-documentation coverage: a usage line with a flag plus required and optional positionals, version substitution with a custom prog, an overridable usage template with repeated ${prog} substitution, a help body rendering an argument default, and a help body with a description only.

cases.expected_output:
usage: helpcli [-h] [--level LEVEL]

optional arguments:
  -h, --help             show this help message and exit
  --level LEVEL           (default: info)

usage: app2 [-h]

Tool description here.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help             show this help message and exit
